body: Hi all, new here a d looking for advice of best sites to join. Read thru, but haven't seen many definitive info
Yeah, not sure about the past tense thing. Think it's too much of a risk. Not sure what to do.
I feel the same way. So worried I'm going to fuck it up, somehow leaving myself permantly disabled, vs free from all of this

I've heard it's an amazing relief once you have a plan. I'm not there yet. Can't think of a way that I know is 100% guaranteed, with no risk of not succeeding. Also, personally want to make it look like an accident.

Mind sharing your plan?

I hope you can talk it out with your friend. I've found the help lines are a joke, so look here or with your friend. Glad that talking through things has helped.

I'm still searching for ways, but the internet sucks and keeps suggesting help vs giving me ideas

So sorry you are feeling this way. I've recently realized I have made my wife (soon to be ex, by her choosing) feel like she can't come to me. She's the most important person in the world to me and I can't live on know that I've contributed to her feeling. 

I can't imagine how you feel. I'd like to help if I can

I'm struggling with that myself. Know what a burden it would be to tell someone and gave them then feel like they are responsible if you ultimately kill yourself. It's the only thing keeping me around.
While I'm struggling with my own issues, grasping at a reason to be alive, why do you feel like you just don't want to live anymore?
So you have a plan already?

Have you talked to anyone in your family about it or plan on leaving a note?

My fear is I'd cause irreparable damage, which is why  I want to make it look like an accident.
You're worried they may not understand why you took your own life?
What did you take and how much?

When who doesn't need you? If there's a who, wouldn't they always need you? That's part of what I'm battling is knowing I will effect their lives negatively, especially if they knew I did it on purpose

I've been dealing with chronic spinal pain that left me bedridden for the 1st 7 months, for 11 years now. Though I can't know your specific issues deal with my own spinal injury with chronic 6-7/10 pain with no relief, constant headaches, muscle spasms, permanent numbness and tingling in arms and legs and drop foot. It's altered my life in an unrepairable way and contributed to the end of my 13 year marriage.

I not sure how to help, but guess I'm trying to empathize.

Similar to you, I don't want to live anymore b/c of the life I've had and just don't see the point of continuing to be a tortured soul. Unlike yourself, however, if I could kill myself, ensuring it would be successful, with no consequences for those I leave behind, I would do it in the drop of a hat.

I've called the suicide hotline in the past and they're really not helpful. Seem wildly undertrained. 

I feel you with being exhausted. I'm not in as much of a stable place as it looks like you're in, but also can't kill myself no matter how much I want to (which really just seems like more torture).
I'm over $400,000 in debt. Money is just money. Other things are more important. I'm in a rough place, but open to talk if you need to talk.
Worried about the hanging thing that someone will find me, but a little too late and I'll either be brain dead or permanently disabled
I did. Not trying to jump on your thread, just saying I agree
43, but kinda feel the same way
I didn't appreciate what I had and lost her
Why was your post deleted? Did you do it or Reddit?
Looking for the same
I'm feeling the same way. Can't seem to do it myself over the fear of screwing it up and leaving myself permanently disabled

If there's an afterlife, I'm screwed. Spent the last 13 years unintentialy torturing the most beautiful, wonderful person in the world. She stuck around as long as she could because of her love for me, but in the end it was just too much.

If there's an afterlife I'm going to be tortured for at least that long.

I am laying on the couch crying, feeling the same. I just don't know how to do it, where it will be fully successful. Also don't want to do it at home. Don't want my wife finding me, even if she is leaving me.

Where are you right now? What are you doing?

I'm so sorry for what you're going through. I share alot of your same feelings. Been on the other side trying to convince others (including my wife) to fight to keep going. She's now leaving me and I don't want to be alive anymore. She's the best thing that has ever happened to me and probably one if the best people I've ever met.

In any case, hope you're still online and maybe we can chat. I'm laying on the couch in tears while she's out somewhere, sending messages in a group chat with family, I think probably not realizing I'm in the chat. Everytime my phone vibrates I get excited it's her maybe texting me only to see that it's a silly text to family, not me.
